### David Rios

I am Hermogenes David Rios, a rising senior studying Economics and Statistics at [Macalester College](https://www.macalester.edu) in Saint Paul, Minnesota. Learn more [about me](./about.html).

### Publications

[**"Inequalities in the U.S. Labor Market":**](/posts/metrics/) Quantified labor market disparities using regression analysis on 500K+ census records. Published in the *Macalester Street Journal: Equilibrium*, Vol. 3 (2025).

### Highlights

**Live It Fund Grant:** Awarded \$2,000 to launch *Camino a la U* in Bolivia, increasing university admission exam scores by 48%.

**DataFest "Best Insight" Award:** Led a team analyzing U.S. real estate trends in a 48-hour data challenge hosted by the American Statistical Association (2025).
